grammar.pattern: 吧 / 了 / 吗 / 呢
grammar.purpose: Hear what a sentence-ending particle does
grammar.explanation: 吧 can suggest a plan or make a tentative assumption. Sentence-final 了 marks a changed situation: 我知道了. 吗 makes a neutral yes/no question from a statement. 呢 can ask “what about…?” or close an ongoing-action statement. They are not interchangeable endings. A word question such as 几点考试 already asks for missing information and does not add 吗.

examples.py: nǐ míng tiān huí jiā ma ?

examples.en: I am at home; what about you?

commonMistakes.why: Do not add 吗 to the question word 几点 in this direct question.

grammar.pattern: 吗? · question word? · A 还是 B? · A-not-A?
grammar.explanation: A yes/no question checks a proposition: 明天考试吗？ A question-word question asks a missing detail: 几点考试？ A choice question offers alternatives: 上午还是下午？ An A-not-A question checks a choice of positive/negative: 考不考？ These are different ways to ask, not four endings to combine. A choice needs an actual offered answer; do not answer a time question only with 是.

examples.py: shàng wǔ hái shi xià wǔ kǎo shì ?
examples.en: Is the exam in the morning or afternoon?
Is there a test tomorrow or not?

commonMistakes.why: Do not combine the direct 还是 alternatives with 吗 here.

grammar.explanation: Add 吗 to an ordinary statement to ask whether it is true: 你买票了 → 你买票了吗？ Answer the specific predicate or give a short fact. This is a neutral question; 不 forms a negative proposition, so 你不回家吗？ may sound surprised in context. Do not mechanically add 吗 to question-word, choice or A-not-A questions.

examples.py: nǐ mǎi jī piào le ma ?
examples.en: Have you bought a plane ticket?

examples.py: nǐ zài wǎng shàng mǎi de ma ?

commonMistakes.why: Use one direct yes/no question structure, not two combined.

lines.zh: 新年我们还一起过吗？你回家吗？
lines.py: xīn nián wǒ men hái yì qǐ guò ma ? nǐ huí jiā ma ?
lines.en: Are we still celebrating the new year together? Are you going home?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 回家。今年是我来北京的第二年，上次没回去。
lines.py: huí jiā . jīn nián shì wǒ lái běi jīng de dì èr nián , shàng cì méi huí qù .
lines.en: I am going home. This is my second year in Beijing; I did not go back last time.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你买机票了吗？在网上买的吗？
lines.py: nǐ mǎi jī piào le ma ? zài wǎng shàng mǎi de ma ?
lines.en: Have you bought a plane ticket? Did you buy it online?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 买了，在网上买的。明天上午飞。
lines.py: mǎi le , zài wǎng shàng mǎi de . míng tiān shàng wǔ fēi .
lines.en: Yes, I bought it online. I fly tomorrow morning.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 上午还是下午？我记得你有考试。
lines.py: shàng wǔ hái shi xià wǔ ? wǒ jì de nǐ yǒu kǎo shì .
lines.en: Morning or afternoon? I remember that you have an exam.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，我明天考汉语，考试是下午。机票要改。
lines.py: duì , wǒ míng tiān kǎo hàn yǔ , kǎo shì shì xià wǔ . jī piào yào gǎi .
lines.en: Right, I have a Chinese test tomorrow afternoon. I need to change the plane ticket.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你知道几点考试吗？
lines.py: nǐ zhī dào jǐ diǎn kǎo shì ma ?
lines.en: Do you know what time the exam is?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不知道。我现在就看通知。你呢？
lines.py: bù zhī dào . wǒ xiàn zài jiù kàn tōng zhī . nǐ ne ?
lines.en: No. I will check the notice right now. What about you?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我在家读书呢。通知的名字是张小姐吗？
lines.py: wǒ zài jiā dú shū ne . tōng zhī de míng zi shì zhāng xiǎo jiě ma ?
lines.en: I am reading at home. Is the name on the notice Miss Zhang?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，是我。网友发给我的通知，先问学校吧。
lines.py: duì , shì wǒ . wǎng yǒu fā gěi wǒ de tōng zhī , xiān wèn xué xiào ba .
lines.en: Yes, that is me. An online friend sent me the notice; I should ask the school first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 请问，明天几点考试？先这样问。
lines.py: qǐng wèn , míng tiān jǐ diǎn kǎo shì ? xiān zhè yàng wèn .
lines.en: “Excuse me, what time is the exam tomorrow?” Ask that first.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，我知道了。先确认考试，再改机票。
lines.py: hǎo , wǒ zhī dào le . xiān què rèn kǎo shì , zài gǎi jī piào .
lines.en: Okay, understood. Confirm the exam first, then change the plane ticket.
lines.speaker: b

lines.py: wǒ zài wǎng shàng mǎi le míng tiān shàng wǔ de jī piào , xiǎng shàng wǔ fēi .
lines.en: I bought an online ticket for tomorrow morning and plan to fly in the morning.

lines.zh: 朋友问我明天考不考汉语，我才想起考试。
lines.py: péng you wèn wǒ míng tiān kǎo bù kǎo hàn yǔ , wǒ cái xiǎng qǐ kǎo shì .
lines.en: A friend asked whether I have a Chinese test tomorrow; only then did I remember the exam.

lines.zh: 我还不知道几点，也不知道这个通知对不对。

lines.zh: 我现在就问学校：请问，明天几点考试？
lines.py: wǒ xiàn zài jiù wèn xué xiào : qǐng wèn , míng tiān jǐ diǎn kǎo shì ?
lines.en: I will ask the school right now: “Excuse me, what time is tomorrow’s exam?”

lines.zh: 先确认考试，再改机票。朋友在家读书呢，我们明天再说吧。
lines.py: xiān què rèn kǎo shì , zài gǎi jī piào . péng you zài jiā dú shū ne , wǒ men míng tiān zài shuō ba .
lines.en: Confirm the exam first, then change the ticket. My friend is reading at home; we will talk again tomorrow.

lines.zh: 上午还是下午？考试几点？先看通知，再问学校。
